name: Anduin Lothar
summary: In Stormwind's royal court, Anduin Lothar grew up beside Prince Llane Wrynn and Medivh. Last of the ancient Arathi bloodline, he led humanity through the First War and united the northern nations in the Second War as Supreme Commander of the Alliance of Lordaeron. His campaign ended at Blackrock Mountain.

sections.title: The Lion's Youth
sections.body: Anduin Lothar grew up in Stormwind's royal court, heir to the bloodline of the Arathi kings. He shared his youth with Prince Llane Wrynn and Medivh. Together, the three ventured recklessly into the wilderness and skirmished with Gurubashi trolls in Stranglethorn Vale. Lothar rose through Stormwind's martial ranks and joined the King's Honor Guard. He also earned renown as an Armsman of the Brotherhood of the Horse.

sections.title: The Fall of Stormwind
sections.body:
When green-skinned invaders poured from the Black Morass, King Llane named Lothar the King's Champion and charged him with defending the kingdom. Lothar ambushed orcish raiding parties in Westfall, the Redridge Mountains, and Elwynn Forest. He outmaneuvered Warchief Blackhand and broke the first siege of Stormwind City.

Then Medivh was revealed as the one who had opened the Dark Portal. Lothar and the apprentice Khadgar stormed Karazhan and executed the corrupted Guardian. They returned to find King Llane assassinated and Stormwind burning. Lothar gathered the survivors, including young Prince Varian, and led them north across the Great Sea.

sections.title: Supreme Commander and Blackrock Mountain
sections.body:
On Lordaeron's shores, Lothar brought King Terenas Menethil II grim news of the Horde. His Arathi lineage and standing as a diplomat helped unite the human realms, Ironforge dwarves, and high elves as the Grand Alliance of Lordaeron. Named Supreme Commander, he led the campaign that drove the Horde south to the foot of Blackrock Mountain.

Near the end of the Second War, Warchief Orgrim Doomhammer slew Lothar in a clash there. His death did not break the Alliance. His lieutenant Turalyon took command and led the charge that broke the Horde forever.

faq.answer: Anduin Lothar was a Stormwind knight and the last descendant of the Arathi bloodline. He served as King's Champion during the First War and became Supreme Commander of the Alliance of Lordaeron in the Second War. Humanity remembers him among its great heroes and tacticians.

Near the end of the Second War, Warchief Orgrim Doomhammer slew Lothar at the foot of Blackrock Mountain. Afterward, Alliance forces under Turalyon routed the Horde and pursued them to the Dark Portal.

faq.q: Why is the current prince named Anduin?
faq.answer: King Varian Wrynn named his young son, Prince Anduin Wrynn, to honor Sir Anduin Lothar. Lothar rescued Varian from Stormwind's ruins, protected him in exile, and gave his life in the Second War as their homeland was reclaimed.

faq.q: What was Lothar's connection to Medivh and King Llane?
faq.answer: Lothar, Prince Llane Wrynn, and the young mage Medivh were childhood friends in Stormwind's royal court. They explored Azeroth and fought trolls and beasts together. Later, Lothar led the strike at Karazhan after Medivh was revealed as the one who opened the Dark Portal and betrayed the realm.

faq.q: Why is Lothar called the 'Last of the Arathi'?
faq.answer: Lothar was the last direct descendant of the ancient Arathi line, the dynasty that united humanity and founded the empire of Arathor millennia ago. That heritage gave him standing with the northern kings when he united them under the Alliance banner in Lordaeron.

faq.q: What was Lothar's role in the Brotherhood of the Horse?
faq.answer: Lothar joined the Brotherhood of the Horse and earned renown as an Armsman. During the First War, he used the order's disciplined cavalry charges to outflank and disrupt Horde formations.

angles.text: To humanity, Lothar is a model of sacrifice and honor. His Arathi blood helped unite the human kingdoms, and he died at Blackrock Mountain as the kingdom was liberated.
Lothar united elves, dwarves, and humans as the Alliance's first Supreme Commander. He led them against the Horde in the Eastern Kingdoms.
Lothar was renowned as an armsman and battlefield commander. His mounted tactics and martial resolve inspire warriors across Azeroth.
Lothar trusted the paladins of the Knights of the Silver Hand, including Turalyon. After Lothar fell, Turalyon took up his shattered sword and led the Alliance to victory.
